  consent_to_share boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the patient consented to share their SDOH information with community-based organizations for referral purposes.']
  data_source varchar [note: 'Primary source of data used to generate the risk stratification, indicating whether from patient screening, EHR data mining, claims analytics, or combined sources.']
  ed_utilization_risk varchar [note: 'Predicted risk level for avoidable emergency department utilization based on SDOH factors, supporting care management outreach prioritization.']
  education_barrier_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the patient reports educational attainment barriers or health literacy challenges affecting care engagement.']
  effective_from date [note: 'Date from which this risk stratification record is considered the current active assessment for the patient, supporting SCD Type 2 historization.']
  effective_to date [note: 'Date until which this risk stratification record is considered current; null indicates the active record. Supports SCD Type 2 historization for temporal analytics.']
  employment_status_concern varchar [note: 'Patient\'s employment status as it relates to SDOH risk, capturing unemployment or underemployment as social risk factors.']
  financial_strain_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the patient screens positive for financial resource strain or inability to meet basic needs.']
  food_insecurity_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the patient screens positive for food insecurity, mapped to ICD-10 Z59.4x codes.']
  geographic_risk_index decimal(5,2) [note: 'Area-level deprivation or risk index score based on patient\'s census tract or ZIP code, incorporating Area Deprivation Index or Social Vulnerability Index data.']
  housing_instability_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the patient screens positive for housing instability or homelessness, mapped to ICD-10 Z59.0x codes.']
  interpersonal_safety_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the patient screens positive for interpersonal violence or safety concerns in the home environment.']
  intervention_type varchar [note: 'Type of intervention recommended or initiated by the community health worker based on the risk assessment findings.']
  is_current boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this is the most recent active risk stratification for the patient, supporting SCD Type 2 pattern for Delta Lake temporal queries.']
  language_barrier_noted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a language barrier was identified during the screening that may affect assessment accuracy or care navigation.']
  need_closure_date date [note: 'Date on which the identified SDOH need was resolved or closed, enabling measurement of time-to-resolution.']
  need_closure_status varchar [note: 'Tracks whether the identified SDOH need has been successfully addressed and closed through intervention or referral completion.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text clinical notes or observations recorded by the assessor regarding the patient\'s social circumstances and risk factors.']
  primary_icd10_z_code varchar [note: 'Primary ICD-10-CM Z-code representing the dominant social determinant identified during screening, used for clinical documentation and billing.']
  prior_risk_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Composite risk score from the most recent previous assessment, enabling trend analysis and intervention effectiveness measurement.']
  program_enrollment_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the population health or value-based care program under which this risk stratification was performed (e.g., ACO, PCMH, Medicaid waiver).']
  readmission_risk varchar [note: 'Predicted risk level for 30-day hospital readmission attributable to unmet social needs, used for discharge planning and transitions of care.']
  reassessment_due_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next SDOH risk reassessment, based on risk tier and organizational protocols.']
  referral_organization_name varchar [note: 'Name of the community-based organization or social service agency to which the patient was referred for SDOH need resolution.']
  referral_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the community-based organization referral generated from this risk assessment for need closure tracking.']
  risk_category varchar [note: 'Overall risk tier assigned to the patient based on composite SDOH scoring, used for population health segmentation and care management prioritization.']
  risk_stratification_status varchar [note: 'Lifecycle status of the risk stratification record indicating whether it is finalized, amended, or voided.']
  score_change_direction varchar [note: 'Direction of change in risk score compared to the prior assessment, supporting population health trend monitoring.']
  screening_completion_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of screening questions answered by the patient, indicating completeness of the assessment data used for scoring.']
  sdoh_domain varchar [note: 'Primary Healthy People 2030 SDOH domain classification for the identified risk, aligning with the five key SDOH areas defined by HHS.']
  secondary_icd10_z_code varchar [note: 'Secondary ICD-10-CM Z-code for an additional social determinant identified, supporting comprehensive SDOH documentation.']

  screening_instrument varchar [note: 'The name of the validated SDOH screening tool or assessment instrument associated with this Z-code (e.g., AHC-HRSN, PRAPARE, Hunger Vital Sign, PHQ-2, HITS). Used to trace the origin of SDOH documentation.']

  sdoh_subcategory varchar [note: 'A more granular classification within the SDOH category, such as food insecurity, housing instability, transportation barriers, unemployment, or social isolation. Used for targeted intervention matching and referral routing.']
  severity_tier varchar [note: 'The severity classification tier assigned to this Z-code for risk stratification and intervention prioritization. Determines urgency of community health worker outreach and referral management.']

Table patient.sdoh_zcode_mapping {
  sdoh_zcode_mapping_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for sdoh_zcode_mapping']
  snomed_concept_id varchar [note: 'The SNOMED CT concept identifier that corresponds to this SDOH Z-code, supporting clinical terminology mapping and interoperability across EHR systems.']
  age_applicability varchar [note: 'The patient age range for which this Z-code is clinically applicable (e.g., pediatric, adult, all ages), supporting clinical decision support and coding validation edits.']
  ahc_domain varchar [note: 'The CMS Accountable Health Communities model domain classification for this Z-code, aligning with the five core AHC screening domains for health-related social needs.']
  billable_code_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this Z-code is a valid billable diagnosis code that can be submitted on claims (UB-04 or CMS-1500) as a primary or secondary diagnosis.']
  clinical_documentation_guidance varchar [note: 'Clinical documentation improvement guidance for providers on when and how to document this Z-code, supporting CDI programs and accurate SDOH capture in the EHR.']
  cms_quality_measure_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this Z-code is referenced in CMS quality measures, HEDIS measures, or value-based payment programs requiring SDOH documentation.']
  code_category_range varchar [note: 'The ICD-10-CM chapter/block range this Z-code belongs to (e.g., Z55-Z65 for persons with potential health hazards related to socioeconomic and psychosocial circumstances).']
  code_description varchar [note: 'The official long description of the ICD-10-CM Z-code as published in the CMS code set, used for clinical documentation and claims submission.']
  code_specificity_level varchar [note: 'The level of specificity of the Z-code: category (3-character), subcategory (4-5 character), or full_code (maximum specificity required for claims).']
  coding_guideline_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific ICD-10-CM Official Coding Guideline section applicable to this Z-code (e.g., Section I.C.21 for factors influencing health status).']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'The date this Z-code was retired or replaced in the ICD-10-CM code set. Null indicates the code is currently active.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'The date this Z-code became effective in the ICD-10-CM code set, used for temporal validity checking during claims processing and clinical documentation.']
  fhir_condition_category varchar [note: 'The FHIR Condition resource category code used when representing this SDOH Z-code in interoperability exchanges, supporting health information exchange (HIE) and care coordination.']
  fiscal_year_introduced varchar [note: 'The CMS fiscal year in which this Z-code was first introduced into the ICD-10-CM code set (e.g., FY2022), supporting version tracking and historical analysis.']
  gender_applicability varchar [note: 'The patient gender for which this Z-code is applicable, used in coding validation edits to prevent inappropriate code assignment.']
  gravity_project_code varchar [note: 'The corresponding code from the Gravity Project SDOH Clinical Care value sets, enabling interoperability with FHIR-based SDOH screening and referral workflows.']
  healthy_people_2030_objective varchar [note: 'The corresponding Healthy People 2030 objective identifier that this SDOH Z-code aligns with, supporting national health improvement priority tracking.']
  icd10_code varchar [note: 'The ICD-10-CM Z-code representing a social determinant of health factor. Z-codes (Z55-Z65) capture circumstances influencing health status and contact with health services related to social and economic factors.']
  intervention_category varchar [note: 'The category of community-based intervention or referral service typically associated with this SDOH need (e.g., housing assistance, food programs, employment services, transportation, utility assistance).']
  last_reviewed_date date [note: 'The date this mapping was last reviewed by clinical informatics or health information management staff for accuracy and currency.']
  loinc_code varchar [note: 'The LOINC code associated with the SDOH screening question or assessment panel that typically generates this Z-code diagnosis, linking screening instruments to coded outcomes.']
  mapping_status varchar [note: 'Current status of this Z-code mapping record indicating whether it is actively used, deprecated due to code retirement, or pending clinical informatics review.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes capturing additional context, exceptions, or special considerations for this Z-code mapping that are not captured in structured fields.']
  parent_code varchar [note: 'The parent code in the ICD-10-CM hierarchy for this Z-code, enabling roll-up reporting and hierarchical navigation of SDOH categories.']
  population_health_priority varchar [note: 'The organizational priority level assigned to this SDOH factor for population health management initiatives, risk stratification, and community health worker intervention targeting.']
  primary_diagnosis_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this Z-code can be reported as the principal/primary diagnosis on a claim or encounter, per ICD-10-CM coding guidelines.']
  reviewed_by varchar [note: 'The identifier or name of the clinical informaticist or HIM professional who last reviewed and validated this mapping record.']
  risk_adjustment_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this Z-code is eligible for inclusion in CMS Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk adjustment models or Medicare Advantage risk scoring.']
  screening_instrument varchar [note: 'The validated screening tool or assessment instrument commonly used to identify this SDOH need (e.g., PRAPARE, AHC-HRSN, HITS, PHQ-2, Hunger Vital Sign).']
  sdoh_domain varchar [note: 'The high-level SDOH domain category this Z-code maps to, such as economic stability, education access, healthcare access, neighborhood/built environment, or social/community context. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: economic_stability|education_access|healthcare_access|neighborhood_environment|social_community_context|food_insecurity|housing_instability — promote to reference product]']
  sdoh_subcategory varchar [note: 'The specific subcategory within the SDOH domain, providing granular classification such as homelessness, food insecurity, unemployment, transportation barriers, or interpersonal violence.']
  short_description varchar [note: 'The abbreviated description of the ICD-10-CM Z-code used in clinical interfaces, charge capture screens, and summary reporting.']
  sort_order varchar [note: 'Numeric sort order for displaying Z-codes in clinical pick lists, screening result summaries, and reporting hierarchies.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'The version of this mapping record, incremented when SDOH domain assignments, terminology crosswalks, or clinical guidance are updated.']

  Note: 'Z‑code mapping table for SDOH codes.'
}

Table patient.community_resource {

  city varchar [note: 'City or municipality where the community resource is physically located.']

  community_resource_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the services, programs, and support offered by the community resource, including scope of assistance and target population served.']

  effective_end_date date [note: 'Date after which this community resource is no longer available for referrals, representing program closure, contract expiration, or seasonal end date. Null for open-ended resources.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'Date from which this community resource became available for referrals, representing the start of its operational period or contract term.']

  funding_source varchar [note: 'Primary funding source for the community resource (e.g., federal grant, state block grant, private foundation, United Way), relevant for sustainability assessment and reporting.']
  hours_of_operation varchar [note: 'Structured or free-text description of the community resource\'s operating hours and days of service availability (e.g., \'Mon-Fri 8:00AM-5:00PM\').']
  icd10_z_code varchar [note: 'ICD-10-CM Z-code associated with the social determinant this resource addresses (e.g., Z59.0 for homelessness, Z59.4 for lack of adequate food), enabling clinical documentation linkage.']
  is_seasonal boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this community resource operates only during specific seasons or time periods (e.g., winter heating assistance, summer meal programs).']
  languages_offered varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of languages in which services are available at this community resource, critical for matching patients with language-appropriate services.']
  latitude decimal(9,6) [note: 'Geographic latitude coordinate of the community resource location, used for proximity-based referral matching and mapping.']
  longitude decimal(9,6) [note: 'Geographic longitude coordinate of the community resource location, used for proximity-based referral matching and mapping.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text administrative notes about the community resource, including special instructions for referrals, known limitations, or internal coordination details.']
  organization_name varchar [note: 'Name of the parent or sponsoring organization that operates or funds this community resource, if different from the resource name itself.']
  partnership_agreement_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the healthcare organization has a formal partnership or memorandum of understanding (MOU) with this community resource for closed-loop referral tracking.']
  phone_number varchar [note: 'Primary contact phone number for the community resource, used by care coordinators and community health workers to initiate referrals.']
  postal_code varchar [note: 'ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the community resource location, used for geographic matching of patients to nearby resources.']
  quality_rating decimal(3,1) [note: 'Aggregate quality or satisfaction rating for the community resource based on patient feedback, care coordinator assessments, or accreditation scores, on a scale of 0.0 to 5.0.']
  record_created_datetime timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this community resource record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data governance requirements.']
  record_updated_datetime timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this community resource record was last modified, supporting data currency tracking and SCD Type 2 change detection.']
  referral_method varchar [note: 'Preferred or accepted method for submitting referrals to this community resource from healthcare organizations or community health workers.']
  referral_turnaround_days varchar [note: 'Expected number of business days from referral submission to initial client contact or service initiation, used for setting patient expectations and follow-up scheduling.']
  resource_type varchar [note: 'Primary classification of the community resource by the type of social need it addresses. Aligns with SDOH domains. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: food_assistance|housing|transportation|employment|education|behavioral_health|legal_services|financial_assistance|childcare|utilities|clothing|substance_use — promote to reference product]']
  sdoh_domain_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code representing the SDOH domain addressed by this resource, aligned with the Gravity Project value sets (e.g., food insecurity, housing instability, transportation access).']
  seasonal_availability_notes varchar [note: 'Description of seasonal availability windows for resources that do not operate year-round (e.g., \'November through March\' for heating assistance).']
  service_area_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the geographic area served by this community resource (e.g., \'All of Franklin County\', \'ZIP codes 43201-43215\'), used for eligibility determination.']
  state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter state or territory code for the community resource location, per USPS standards.']
  taxonomy_code varchar [note: 'Alliance of Information and Referral Systems (AIRS) taxonomy code classifying the specific service type offered, enabling standardized categorization across community information exchanges.']
  transportation_available_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the community resource provides or arranges transportation for clients to access services, critical for patients with transportation barriers.']
  verification_date date [note: 'Date when the community resource information was last verified for accuracy by a care coordinator, community health worker, or resource directory administrator.']
  verified_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the staff member who last verified the accuracy of this community resource record.']
  website_url varchar [note: 'Official website URL for the community resource where patients and care teams can find additional information about services and eligibility.']

  Note: 'Master reference table for community_resource. Referenced by community_resource_id.'
}

  handoff_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier or note key pointing to the handoff documentation record created when this provider transferred care responsibility to another provider. Supports care continuity, patient safety, and Joint Commission handoff communication standards.']
  is_attending_of_record boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this provider is designated as the attending physician of record for the visit. The attending of record bears overall clinical and legal responsibility for the patients care and is reported on all billing claims.']
  is_primary_provider boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this provider holds primary clinical and billing responsibility for the visit. Only one provider per visit should have this flag set to True. Drives attending physician attribution on claims, UB-04, and CMS-1500 forms.']
  locum_tenens_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the provider is serving in a locum tenens (temporary substitute) capacity for this visit. Locum tenens billing has specific CMS rules requiring the Q6 modifier on claims.']
  mips_eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this providers participation in this visit is eligible for MIPS (Merit-based Incentive Payment System) performance measurement under MACRA (Medicare Access and CHIP Reauthorization Act). Drives quality measure attribution.']
  note_count varchar [note: 'Number of clinical notes authored or co-signed by this provider for this visit. Supports CDI (Clinical Documentation Improvement) completeness tracking and provider documentation compliance reporting.']
  npi varchar [note: 'The 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the assigned provider as issued by CMS. Captured at time of assignment to support billing, claims adjudication, and RVU (Relative Value Unit) attribution independent of provider master record changes.']
  on_call_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this provider was assigned to the visit as part of an on-call coverage rotation rather than a scheduled or direct assignment. Supports on-call scheduling analytics and EMTALA (Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act) compliance tracking.']
  order_count varchar [note: 'Number of clinical orders (lab, radiology, pharmacy, procedures) placed by this provider via CPOE (Computerized Physician Order Entry) for this visit. Supports provider ordering pattern analytics and CPOE adoption reporting.']
  participation_duration_minutes varchar [note: 'Total number of minutes the provider was actively engaged in this visit, calculated from assignment_start_timestamp to assignment_end_timestamp. Used for time-based billing (e.g., anesthesia, critical care), provider productivity reporting, and staffing analytics.']
  place_of_service_code varchar [note: 'Two-digit CMS Place of Service (POS) code indicating the setting where the provider rendered services during this visit (e.g., 11=Office, 21=Inpatient Hospital, 23=Emergency Room, 02=Telehealth). Required on CMS-1500 professional claims.']
  privilege_type varchar [note: 'The type of clinical privileges held by the provider at the facility for this visit assignment (e.g., full, provisional, temporary, locum tenens, telemedicine). Determines scope of permissible clinical activities.']
  provider_assignment_end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the providers active participation in this visit ended. Null if the provider is still actively assigned. Used for LOS (Length of Stay) attribution, handoff documentation, and coverage gap analysis.']
  provider_assignment_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the providers active participation in this visit began. Used for time-bounded care team tracking, shift coverage analysis, and provider performance analytics per encounter.']
  provider_assignment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the providers assignment to this visit. active indicates current participation; transferred indicates a handoff to another provider has occurred; cancelled indicates the assignment was voided.']
  provider_assignment_type varchar [note: 'Indicates how the provider came to be assigned to this visit — whether through scheduled care, unscheduled walk-in, emergency response, on-call coverage, or formal consult request. Supports operational staffing and care coordination analytics.']
  provider_role varchar [note: 'Clinical role of the provider for this specific visit assignment (e.g., attending, consulting, admitting, covering, resident, hospitalist, surgeon, anesthesiologist, PCP). Determines care team hierarchy, billing responsibility, and RVU attribution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: attending|consulting|admitting|covering|resident|hospitalist|surgeon|anesthesiologist|pcp|co_surgeon|scrub_tech|circulating_nurse|care_coordinator — promote to reference product]']
  provider_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the providers credential type for this assignment (e.g., physician, NP (Nurse Practitioner), PA (Physician Assistant), resident, fellow, student, RN, CRNA). Determines billing rules, supervision requirements, and scope of practice. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physician|np|pa|resident|fellow|student|rn|crna|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  rendering_provider_npi varchar [note: 'The NPI (National Provider Identifier) of the individual clinician who actually rendered the service during this visit. Distinct from billing_provider_npi when services are billed under a group or supervising provider.']
  rvu_credit_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this provider assignment is eligible to receive RVU (Relative Value Unit) credit for services rendered during this visit. Used in provider productivity reporting, compensation modeling, and MIPS (Merit-based Incentive Payment System) performance tracking.']
  rvu_work_units decimal(10,4) [note: 'The physician work RVU (wRVU) value attributed to this provider for services rendered during this visit assignment. Sourced from CMS RBRVS fee schedule and used for provider productivity measurement and compensation calculations.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this provider assignment record was sourced (e.g., Epic ClinDoc, Cerner PowerChart, MEDITECH). Supports data lineage, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) audit, and reconciliation.']
  source_system_record_code varchar [note: 'The native identifier of this provider assignment record in the originating operational system (e.g., Epic ClinDoc provider assignment ID, Cerner care team member ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit.']
  specialty_at_assignment varchar [note: 'The clinical specialty of the provider at the time of this visit assignment, captured as a point-in-time snapshot. Supports specialty-based care team analytics and quality reporting independent of provider master record updates.']
  telehealth_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the providers participation in this visit was conducted via telehealth modality. Affects billing modifier requirements, place of service codes, and state telehealth licensure compliance.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this visit-provider association record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, SCD (Slowly Changing Dimension) processing, and audit compliance.']

  Note: 'Association entity linking providers to a visit with their specific role and time-bounded participation.   drg_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to reference.drg. Business justification: Core DRG grouping workflow—every DRG assignment must reference the official DRG definition for payment calculation, case mix index reporting, expected LOS comparison, and reimbursement validation. Ess']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the HIM (Health Information Management) coder who finalized the DRG assignment. Supports coding productivity reporting, quality audits, and compliance tracking.']
  mpi_record_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the patient associated with this DRG assignment, supporting CMI analysis and population health reporting.']
  payer_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the primary payer (insurance plan) for this encounter. Determines which DRG version and payment methodology applies (e.g., MS-DRG for Medicare, APR-DRG for Medicaid managed care).']
  visit_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the inpatient or observation encounter for which this DRG assignment was generated. Links the DRG record to the core encounter event.']
  actual_los decimal(6,2) [note: 'The actual number of days the patient was hospitalized for this encounter, calculated from admission to discharge. Compared against geometric and arithmetic mean LOS for efficiency and outlier analysis.']
  admit_source_code varchar [note: 'The UB-04 admission source code indicating how the patient was admitted (e.g., 1=Physician Referral, 4=Transfer from Hospital, 7=Emergency Room). Influences DRG grouping logic for certain MDCs.']
  arithmetic_mean_los decimal(6,2) [note: 'The arithmetic mean length of stay in days for the assigned DRG, published by CMS. Used alongside geometric mean LOS for outlier threshold determination and payer contract benchmarking.']
  base_payment_rate decimal(12,2) [note: 'The hospital-specific or payer-contracted base payment rate (in USD) applied to the DRG weight to calculate expected reimbursement. Reflects IPPS standardized amount or negotiated payer contract rate.']
  cc_mcc_flag varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the encounter qualifies for a Complication and Comorbidity (CC) or Major Complication and Comorbidity (MCC) designation, which elevates the DRG tier and associated reimbursement weight. Critical CDI target for revenue optimization.']
  cdi_query_count varchar [note: 'The number of CDI queries issued to the attending physician for this encounter to clarify or improve clinical documentation supporting the DRG assignment. Key CDI productivity and impact metric.']
  cdi_query_response_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether at least one CDI query for this encounter received a physician response that resulted in a documentation change affecting the DRG assignment. Measures CDI program effectiveness.']
  claim_appeal_status varchar [note: 'Current status of any payer or RAC appeal related to this DRG assignment. Tracks the outcome of reimbursement disputes through the appeals process.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this DRG assignment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.']
  discharge_status_code varchar [note: 'The UB-04 patient discharge status code (01–99) indicating the disposition of the patient at discharge (e.g., 01=Home, 02=SNF, 20=Expired). Affects DRG payment under post-acute care transfer rules.']
  drg_changed_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the DRG code was changed from the initial working DRG to the final assigned DRG, typically as a result of CDI query responses or coding review. Tracks CDI program impact on reimbursement.']
  drg_description varchar [note: 'Full text description of the assigned DRG code (e.g., SIMPLE PNEUMONIA AND PLEURISY W MCC). Used in clinical documentation improvement workflows and reimbursement reporting.']
  drg_version varchar [note: 'The DRG classification system version used for grouping: MS-DRG (Medicare Severity), APR-DRG (All Patient Refined), or IR-DRG (International Refined). Determines the applicable reimbursement methodology and payer contract.']
  drg_version_number varchar [note: 'The specific fiscal year or release version of the DRG grouper applied (e.g., v41 for MS-DRG Version 41). Required for audit trails and reimbursement reconciliation across fiscal year transitions.']
  drg_weight decimal(10,4) [note: 'The relative weight assigned to the DRG, reflecting the average resource intensity of cases in that group relative to the average Medicare case. Used to calculate CMI and expected reimbursement from the base payment rate.']
  expected_reimbursement decimal(12,2) [note: 'The calculated expected reimbursement amount (in USD) derived from DRG weight multiplied by the base payment rate, before outlier adjustments. Used for revenue forecasting and variance analysis against actual payments.']
  finalized_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the DRG assignment was finalized by the coding team, triggering claim submission eligibility. Key milestone in the revenue cycle management workflow.']
  geometric_mean_los decimal(6,2) [note: 'The geometric mean length of stay in days for the assigned DRG, published by CMS. Used as a benchmark for LOS efficiency analysis and outlier payment threshold calculations.']
  grouper_software varchar [note: 'Name of the DRG grouper software used to assign the DRG (e.g., 3M Grouper Plus, OptumInsight Encoder). Required for audit trails and reimbursement dispute resolution.']
  grouper_software_version varchar [note: 'The specific release version of the grouper software applied (e.g., 3M Grouper Plus v32.1). Critical for audit compliance and reimbursement reconciliation when grouper logic changes between versions.']
  grouping_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the DRG grouper software was executed and the DRG code was assigned. Used for tracking CDI workflow timelines and coding productivity.']
  initial_drg_code varchar [note: 'The DRG code assigned at the initial working grouping (typically at admission or during the stay), before final coding and CDI review. Compared against the final DRG to measure CDI program impact and reimbursement uplift.']
  initial_drg_weight decimal(10,4) [note: 'The DRG relative weight associated with the initial working DRG code. Used to calculate the reimbursement uplift achieved through CDI and coding optimization.']
  is_outlier boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this encounter qualifies as a cost outlier under CMS IPPS policy, triggering additional outlier payment beyond the standard DRG payment. True when actual costs exceed the fixed-loss threshold.']
  mdc_code varchar [note: 'The Major Diagnostic Category code (01–25 plus PRE for pre-MDC) that serves as the primary clinical grouping tier above the DRG. Derived from the principal diagnosis and used for service-line analytics and CMI benchmarking.']
  mdc_description varchar [note: 'Full text description of the MDC (e.g., Diseases and Disorders of the Respiratory System). Supports service-line reporting and clinical program analytics.']
  outlier_payment decimal(12,2) [note: 'Additional payment amount (in USD) approved for high-cost outlier cases where actual costs exceed the fixed-loss outlier threshold. Applicable under CMS IPPS cost outlier policy.']
  patient_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the encounter type for DRG assignment purposes: inpatient (full admission), observation (outpatient observation status), or short_stay. Determines DRG applicability and reimbursement methodology.']
  principal_diagnosis_code varchar [note: 'The ICD-10-CM code for the principal diagnosis — the condition established after study to be chiefly responsible for the admission. Drives DRG grouping logic and is a key CDI target for reimbursement optimization.']
  principal_diagnosis_description varchar [note: 'Full text description of the principal ICD-10-CM diagnosis code. Supports CDI workflow review, clinical documentation audits, and payer communication.']
  principal_procedure_code varchar [note: 'The ICD-10-PCS code for the principal procedure performed during the encounter. Surgical procedures are the primary driver of DRG partition assignment (surgical vs. medical) and reimbursement weight.']
  procedure_count varchar [note: 'The total number of ICD-10-PCS procedure codes submitted on the claim. Surgical procedures drive DRG assignment into surgical partitions, significantly affecting reimbursement weight.']
  provider_assignment_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow status of the DRG assignment record: preliminary (initial grouping), final (coding complete and validated), amended (revised after CDI query or audit), or voided (invalidated). Drives revenue cycle workflow routing.']
  provider_assignment_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the nature of the DRG assignment: initial (first grouping at admission), working (interim CDI grouping), final (post-discharge coding), appeal (payer dispute), or rac_review (Recovery Audit Contractor review). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial|working|final|appeal|rac_review — promote to reference product]']
  rac_review_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this DRG assignment has been selected for review by a Recovery Audit Contractor (RAC) under the CMS RAC program. Triggers additional documentation retention and appeal workflow.']
  secondary_diagnosis_count varchar [note: 'The total number of secondary (additional) ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes submitted on the claim. Influences CC/MCC determination and DRG tier assignment; a key CDI metric for documentation completeness.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this DRG assignment record was sourced (e.g., Epic Resolute HB, 3M Grouper Plus). Required for data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL audit purposes.']
  transfer_case_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this encounter is a transfer case subject to the post-acute care transfer (PACT) policy, which may reduce DRG payment when the patient is transferred to a post-acute care setting before the geometric mean LOS.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this DRG assignment record was last modified. Tracks amendments from CDI queries, coding audits, or payer appeals.']

  Note: 'DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) assignment record for inpatient and observation encounters, capturing the assigned DRG code, DRG version (MS-DRG, APR-DRG, IR-DRG), DRG weight, geometric mean LOS, arithmetic mean LOS, MDC (Major Diagnostic Category), CC/MCC (Complication and Comorbidity) flags, principal diagnosis ICD-10 code, and grouper software version. Supports CMI (Case Mix Index) calculation, reimbursement optimization, and CDI (Clinical Documentation Improvement) workflows. Sourced from 3M Health Information Systems grouper and Epic Resolute HB.'
}

  network_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the rendering provider and/or facility is in-network or out-of-network with the patients insurance plan for this visit. Affects patient cost-sharing and reimbursement rates.']
  out_of_pocket_max decimal(12,2) [note: 'Maximum annual dollar amount the patient is required to pay out-of-pocket for covered services under the insurance plan. Once met, the plan covers 100% of covered services.']
  out_of_pocket_met_amount decimal(12,2) [note: 'Dollar amount of the patients annual out-of-pocket maximum that has already been satisfied as of the date of this visit. Used to determine remaining patient financial liability.']
  payer_phone varchar [note: 'Primary contact phone number for the insurance payers provider services or claims department. Used by revenue cycle staff for eligibility verification and claims follow-up.']
  preauth_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the payer requires prior authorization for the services rendered during this visit. True = pre-authorization is required; False = no pre-authorization needed.']
  referral_number varchar [note: 'Referral authorization number issued by the patients Primary Care Physician (PCP) or gatekeeper for HMO/POS plans requiring referrals for specialist or facility services during this visit.']
  reimbursement_method varchar [note: 'Expected payment methodology under which the payer will reimburse the provider for this visit. FFS = Fee-For-Service; CAPITATION = per-member per-month; BUNDLED = bundled payment; VBP = Value-Based Purchasing; DRG = Diagnosis-Related Group; PER_DIEM = daily rate.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which this visit insurance record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL audit in the Databricks Silver lakehouse layer.']
  subscriber_dob date [note: 'Date of birth of the primary policyholder (subscriber). Used for eligibility verification and claims adjudication when the patient is a dependent.']
  subscriber_relationship varchar [note: 'Relationship of the patient to the primary policyholder (subscriber). Determines dependent eligibility and COB rules. Values: SELF (patient is the subscriber), SPOUSE, CHILD, OTHER. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SELF|SPOUSE|CHILD|DOMESTIC_PARTNER|WARD|EMPLOYEE|UNKNOWN|OTHER — promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this visit insurance record was last modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and downstream ETL processing in the Databricks Silver layer.']

  Note: 'Insurance coverage and payer information associated with a specific visit, capturing primary, secondary, and tertiary payer details, plan name, group number, member ID, subscriber relationship, coverage verification status, authorization number, pre-authorization requirements, financial class, expected reimbursement method (FFS, capitation, bundled payment, VBP), and coordination of benefits sequence. SSOT for payer-visit linkage within the encounter domain. Sourced from Epic Resolute HB and Cerner Revenue Cycle eligibility verification.'
}

Table encounter.visit_status_history {
  visit_status_history_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each visit status history record. Primary key for the visit_status_history data product in the encounter domain.']
  bed_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific bed assigned to the patient at the time of this status change. Supports bed management, occupancy tracking, and throughput analysis.']
  clinician_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the attending physician responsible for the patient at the time of this status change. Supports provider-level throughput and LOS analysis.']
  demographics_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the patient associated with the visit. Enables patient-level throughput and LOS milestone analysis without requiring a join to the visit table.']
  employee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the system user (clinician, registrar, or automated process) who initiated or recorded the status change. Used for workflow auditing and accountability tracking.']
  message_log_id varchar [note: 'The HL7 message control ID (MSH-10) from the ADT message that triggered this status change. Enables traceability back to the originating HL7 ADT message for interface troubleshooting and audit.']
  org_unit_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical department or unit associated with this status change event (e.g., ED, ICU, Med-Surg). Supports department-level throughput and capacity analysis.']
  primary_visit_care_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the facility or hospital where the visit status change occurred. Enables multi-facility throughput comparison and operational reporting.']
  visit_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent visit/encounter record for which this status change event is recorded. Links the status history to the core encounter.']
  admission_source_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code indicating the source from which the patient was admitted at the time of an admission status event (e.g., emergency room, physician referral, transfer from another facility). Relevant for admit-type status transitions. Aligns with UB-04 FL-15.']
  adt_event_reason_code varchar [note: 'Coded reason for the ADT event or status change as defined by the source system or HL7 standard (e.g., elective admission, emergency, transfer for higher level of care). Supports root-cause analysis of status transitions.']
  adt_event_type varchar [note: 'HL7 ADT event type code that triggered this status change (e.g., A01=Admit, A02=Transfer, A03=Discharge, A04=Register Outpatient, A05=Pre-Admit, A06=Change Outpatient to Inpatient). Enables HL7-aligned event classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: A01|A02|A03|A04|A05|A06|A07|A08|A09|A10|A11|A12|A13|A21|A22|A38|A40 — promote to reference product]']
  care_setting varchar [note: 'Physical or virtual care setting where the patient was located at the time of this status change (e.g., ED, ICU, OR, inpatient unit, outpatient clinic, observation unit, telehealth). Supports care setting transition analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ED|ICU|OR|inpatient_unit|outpatient_clinic|observation_unit|telehealth — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  changed_by_role varchar [note: 'Functional role of the user who performed the status change (e.g., physician, nurse, registrar, care coordinator, system). Enables role-based throughput and workflow analysis.']
  changed_by_user_name varchar [note: 'Display name of the user who initiated the status change. Carried on the record to support audit reporting without requiring a join to the user directory.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this visit status history record was first created in the data platform. Distinct from status_change_timestamp which reflects the real-world event time. Used for audit trail and ETL lineage.']
  department_name varchar [note: 'Name of the clinical department or unit at the time of the status change. Carried on the record to support reporting without requiring a join to the department reference table.']
  discharge_disposition_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code indicating the patients disposition at the time of a discharge status event (e.g., home, skilled nursing facility, expired, AMA). Aligns with UB-04 FL-17 and CMS discharge disposition codes. Relevant for discharge-type status transitions.']
  duration_in_status_minutes varchar [note: 'Number of minutes the visit remained in the previous status before transitioning to the new status. Calculated at ingestion time from consecutive status_change_timestamps. Supports LOS milestone tracking and throughput bottleneck analysis.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the status change became effective. Derived from status_change_timestamp for date-level partitioning, daily census reporting, and operational dashboards.']
  encounter_number varchar [note: 'Human-readable, externally visible encounter or visit number assigned by the source system (e.g., Epic CSN or Cerner FIN). Used for cross-system reconciliation and operational reporting.']
  financial_class varchar [note: 'Financial class or payer category of the visit at the time of this status change (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, Self-Pay). Supports payer-stratified throughput and LOS analysis.']
  is_corrected boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this status history record is a correction of a previously entered status change. True if this record supersedes an erroneous prior entry. Supports data quality auditing and HIM correction workflows.']
  is_current_status boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this record represents the most recent (current) status of the visit. True for the latest status record; False for all prior status records. Enables efficient current-state queries without window functions.']
  is_system_generated boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this status change was automatically generated by the source system (e.g., automated bed assignment, scheduled discharge trigger) rather than manually entered by a user. Supports audit quality and workflow automation analysis.']
  los_at_event_hours decimal(10,2) [note: 'Cumulative length of stay in hours from the initial admission or arrival timestamp to the time of this status change event. Supports LOS milestone tracking and throughput benchmarking at each status transition point.']
  mrn varchar [note: 'Medical Record Number assigned to the patient by the facility. Carried on the status history record to support operational auditing and patient-level throughput reporting without requiring upstream joins.']
  new_status varchar [note: 'The visit status assigned as a result of this status change event. Represents the current state of the visit at the time of this record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|pre-registered|arrived|admitted|in-progress|observation|transferred|discharged|cancelled|no-show|left-without-being-seen — promote to reference product]']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or comments entered by the user at the time of the status change. May include clinical context, operational instructions, or escalation notes. Supports workflow auditing and care coordination.']
  previous_status varchar [note: 'The visit status immediately before this status change event occurred. Null for the initial status record. Used to reconstruct the full status transition chain. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|pre-registered|arrived|admitted|in-progress|observation|transferred|discharged|cancelled|no-show|left-without-being-seen — promote to reference product]']
  room_number varchar [note: 'Room number assigned to the patient at the time of this status change. Relevant for bed assignment, transfer, and discharge events. Supports bed management and capacity planning.']
  sequence_number varchar [note: 'Ordinal sequence number of this status change event within the visit lifecycle, starting at 1. Enables chronological ordering of status transitions for a given visit without relying solely on timestamps.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record that originated this status change event (e.g., Epic ADT, Cerner Millennium ADT, MEDITECH Expanse, manual entry, HL7 interface). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.']
  source_system_event_code varchar [note: 'The native event or transaction identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Epic ADT event ID, Cerner Millennium event ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation, deduplication, and ETL lineage tracking.']
  status_change_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text or coded narrative reason entered by the user or system explaining why the visit status was changed (e.g., Patient arrived at ED triage, Bed assigned in ICU, Patient left without being seen). Supports operational workflow auditing.']
  status_change_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time when the visit status transition occurred. Principal event timestamp for this record. Used for LOS milestone tracking, throughput analysis, and ADT event sequencing.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this visit status history record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental ETL processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.']

  Note: 'Chronological audit trail of all status changes for a visit throughout its lifecycle (scheduled, pre-registered, arrived, admitted, in-progress, observation, transferred, discharged, cancelled, no-show, left-without-being-seen). Captures previous status, new status, status change timestamp, changed-by user, and reason for status change. Enables LOS milestone tracking, throughput analysis, and operational workflow auditing. Sourced from Epic ADT and Cerner Millennium event log.'
}

  transfer_reason_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code representing the reason for transfer (e.g., higher level of care, specialty service unavailable, patient request, capacity constraints).']
  transfer_request_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier for the transfer request, used for tracking and communication between facilities.']
  transfer_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the transfer request. Tracks the request from initial submission through completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: requested|pending_approval|approved|in_progress|completed|cancelled|denied — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  transfer_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the transfer request based on scope and urgency. Inter-facility transfers occur between different healthcare organizations, intra-facility transfers occur within the same organization.']
  transport_mode varchar [note: 'Method of transportation used or planned for the patient transfer.']
  transport_provider varchar [note: 'Name of the ambulance service, air transport company, or other transportation provider responsible for the transfer.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this transfer request record was last modified.']

  Note: 'Inter-facility and intra-facility patient transfer request records with EMTALA compliance tracking.'
}

Table encounter.visit_coverage {
  visit_coverage_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the visit_coverage association']
  payer_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the insurance payer providing coverage for this visit']
  visit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the patient visit record that this coverage applies to']
  authorization_number varchar [note: 'Unique authorization or referral number issued by the payer approving coverage for this specific visit. Required on claim submission for services requiring prior authorization. Obtained during pre-registration or admission process and specific to this visit-payer combination.']
  authorization_status varchar [note: 'Current status of prior authorization for this visit-payer combination. Approved indicates payer has authorized coverage for the planned services. Not Required indicates payer does not require authorization for this visit type or service category. Drives admission clearance and claim submission readiness.']
  copay_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Fixed dollar amount the patient owes at time of service per the benefit plan for this payer. Collected at registration or discharge. Amount is specific to this visit-payer combination and varies by payer contract and patient benefit plan.']
  coverage_effective_date date [note: 'Date on which the patients coverage with this payer became active. Retrieved from eligibility verification. Used to validate that coverage was active on the date of service for this visit.']
  coverage_sequence varchar [note: 'Indicates the order of financial responsibility when multiple payers cover a single visit. Primary payer is billed first, secondary covers remaining balance per coordination of benefits rules, tertiary covers after secondary. Critical for claim submission sequencing and coordination of benefits processing.']
  coverage_termination_date date [note: 'Date on which the patients coverage with this payer ends or ended. Retrieved from eligibility verification. Null for active open-ended coverage. Used to validate coverage was active on date of service and to flag potential coverage gaps.']
  deductible_met_amount decimal(10,2) [note: 'Dollar amount of the annual deductible the patient has already satisfied with this payer at the time of visit registration. Retrieved from eligibility verification response. Used to calculate patient financial responsibility and estimate out-of-pocket costs for this visit.']
  eligibility_status varchar [note: 'Status of real-time eligibility verification performed at visit registration or admission. Verified indicates active coverage confirmed via EDI 270/271 transaction or payer portal. Drives financial counseling, authorization requirements, and registration workflow completion.']
  eligibility_verification_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when real-time eligibility verification was performed with this payer for this visit. Documents when coverage was confirmed and provides audit trail for registration compliance and claim denial prevention.']
  network_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the facility or attending provider is in-network or out-of-network for this specific payer. Determines reimbursement rates, patient cost-sharing levels, and claim adjudication rules. Retrieved during eligibility verification and specific to this visit-payer relationship.']
  subscriber_relationship varchar [note: 'Relationship of the patient to the insurance subscriber (policyholder) for this payer. Self indicates patient is the policyholder. Required for claim submission and coordination of benefits processing. Specific to this visit-payer combination as patient may have different relationships with different payers.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the insurance coverage relationship between a patient visit and a payer. It captures the coordination of benefits when multiple payers cover a single visit, tracking coverage sequence (primary, secondary, tertiary), eligibility verification status, prior authorization details, and financial responsibility allocation. Each record links one visit to one payer with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific coverage instance.. Existence Justification: In healthcare operations, a single patient visit routinely involves multiple insurance payers through coordination of benefits (COB)—primary, secondary, and tertiary coverage. Each payer relationship requires distinct eligibility verification, prior authorization tracking, coverage sequencing, and financial responsibility determination. Conversely, each payer covers thousands of visits across the healthcare organization. The visit-payer relationship is an operational business entity actively managed during registration, admission, and billing workflows.'
}

Table encounter.visit_recall_impact {
  visit_recall_impact_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for the visit_recall_impact association']
  assigned_to_clinician_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinician assigned to conduct the clinical review and patient notification for this visit-recall combination. Supports patient safety workflow assignment and accountability.']
  recall_notice_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the recall notice that potentially affects this visit based on supply usage during the encounter.']
  visit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the patient visit that may have been exposed to the recalled medical supply, device, or implant during the encounter.']
  clinical_review_completed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a clinical review has been completed to assess the actual patient impact for this specific visit-recall combination. Clinical review determines if the recalled product was actually used on this patient and what clinical follow-up is required.']
  clinical_review_date date [note: 'Date on which the clinical review was completed for this visit-recall combination. Used to track compliance with patient safety investigation timelines.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this visit-recall impact record was created in the system, typically when the recall was matched to potentially affected visits through supply chain traceability analysis.']
  follow_up_due_date date [note: 'Target date by which clinical follow-up should be completed for this visit-recall combination. Used for patient safety task management and compliance tracking.']
  follow_up_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether ongoing clinical follow-up is required for this patient based on the recall impact assessment. Drives care coordination and patient safety monitoring workflows.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this visit-recall impact record, tracking the progression of the patient safety investigation and notification workflow.']
  lot_serial_match_confirmed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the specific lot number or serial number of the product used in this visit matches the affected lot/serial range specified in the recall notice. Critical for determining actual patient exposure.']
  notification_date date [note: 'Date on which the patient associated with this visit was formally notified of potential exposure to the recalled product. Used for regulatory compliance tracking and patient safety audit trails.']
  patient_impact_assessment varchar [note: 'Clinical assessment of the actual or potential impact of the recalled product on this specific patient during this visit. Categorizes risk level and drives notification urgency and remediation priority.']
  patient_notification_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the patient notification workflow for this visit-recall combination. Tracks whether the patient has been notified of potential exposure to the recalled product, supporting FDA MedWatch and patient safety regulatory requirements.']
  product_actually_used boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the recalled product was definitively confirmed to have been used on this patient during this visit. Determined through supply chain traceability, clinical documentation review, and UDI tracking.']
  remediation_action_taken varchar [note: 'Specific remediation action taken for this visit-recall combination based on clinical review findings. Documents the healthcare organizations response to the recall for this specific patient encounter.']
  remediation_date date [note: 'Date on which the remediation action was completed for this visit-recall combination. Used for regulatory compliance tracking and patient safety audit trails.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the patient safety tracking relationship between visit and recall_notice. It captures the regulatory-required tracking of which patient visits were potentially affected by medical supply recalls, the notification and remediation workflow status for each visit-recall combination, and the clinical assessment of patient impact. Each record links one visit to one recall_notice with attributes that exist only in the context of this patient safety investigation and notification workflow.. Existence Justification: In healthcare operations, a single patient visit can be affected by multiple different recall notices if multiple recalled products were used during the encounter (e.g., different implants, devices, or supplies). Conversely, a single recall notice affects multiple patient visits—every patient who received the recalled product must be identified, notified, and clinically assessed. The healthcare organization must actively manage each visit-recall combination as a distinct patient safety investigation with its own notification status, clinical review, and remediation workflow.'
}

Table provider.privileging {
  privileging_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each clinical privileging record granted to a clinician at a specific facility. Primary key for this data product.']
  audit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Clinical privileges are audited for compliance with credentialing standards (TJC MS.06.01.05, CMS 482.12). Compliance teams audit privilege files for documentation of training, case volume, FPPE/OPPE,']
  care_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific hospital, clinic, or healthcare facility at which the clinical privileges are granted and exercised. Privileges are facility-specific per Joint Commission standards.']
  org_unit_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical department or service line (e.g., Surgery, Cardiology, Emergency Medicine) under whose scope the privileges are administered and reviewed.']
  primary_privileging_clinician_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the licensed clinician or healthcare professional to whom clinical privileges are granted. Links to the provider master record.']
  provider_committee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the medical staff committee (e.g., Credentials Committee, Medical Executive Committee) that reviewed and approved the privilege grant. Required for Joint Commission accreditation documentation.']
  specialty_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Clinical privileges are granted for specific specialties. privileging.specialty_code and specialty_name should reference specialty table as authoritative source.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the approving medical staff committee formally voted to grant or renew the clinical privileges. Distinct from the effective date, which may be retroactive or future-dated.']
  board_certification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether board certification in the relevant specialty is a prerequisite for granting this privilege per the facilitys medical staff bylaws. True when board certification is required.']
  completed_case_volume varchar [note: 'Actual number of cases or procedures performed by the clinician under this privilege during the current privilege period. Used for ongoing competency assessment and reappointment decisions.']
  cpt_code varchar [note: 'American Medical Association (AMA) Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) code associated with the primary procedure covered by this privilege. Used to align privileging with billing authorization and quality measurement.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this privileging record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with HIPAA Security Rule audit control requirements.']
  delineation_form_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the privilege delineation form used to define the scope of this privilege grant. Tracks which version of the approved privilege form was in effect at the time of granting, supporting audit and accreditation review.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the clinical privilege grant becomes active and the clinician is authorized to perform the privileged procedures at the facility. Binding start date per medical staff bylaws.']
  emtala_covered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this privilege covers emergency on-call obligations under EMTALA (Emergency Medical Treatment and Labor Act). True when the clinician is authorized and obligated to respond to emergency department on-call requests under this privilege.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the clinical privilege grant expires and must be renewed through the reappointment process. Typically aligned with the medical staff reappointment cycle (commonly every 2 years per TJC standards).']
  fppe_completion_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) was completed and findings were submitted to the medical staff committee. Null when FPPE is not required or not yet completed.']
  fppe_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a Focused Professional Practice Evaluation (FPPE) is required for this privilege grant. FPPE is mandatory for all new privileges and triggered by performance concerns per TJC standards. True when FPPE is required.']
  icd10_procedure_code varchar [note: 'ICD-10-PCS procedure code corresponding to the privileged procedure, used for inpatient procedure coding alignment and quality reporting. Applicable primarily for surgical and procedural privileges.']
  is_provisional boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the privilege is granted on a provisional basis, requiring supervision or proctoring during an initial evaluation period before full privileges are confirmed. True when provisional; False when full privileges are granted.']
  malpractice_verified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the clinicians malpractice/professional liability insurance coverage has been verified as current and meeting the facilitys minimum coverage requirements at the time of privilege grant. True when verified.']
  npdb_report_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the adverse action was reported to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB). Must occur within 15 days of the adverse action per HCQIA requirements. Null when no NPDB report is required.']
  npdb_report_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether an adverse action report to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) is required for this privilege action (e.g., suspension >30 days, revocation). True triggers mandatory NPDB reporting workflow.']
  oppe_last_review_date date [note: 'Calendar date of the most recent Ongoing Professional Practice Evaluation (OPPE) review for this privilege. OPPE must occur at regular intervals (at least every 12 months) per TJC standards to support reappointment.']
  peer_review_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Numeric score or rating assigned during the most recent peer review or focused professional practice evaluation (FPPE) or ongoing professional practice evaluation (OPPE) for this privilege. Used to support reappointment decisions. Sensitive business-confidential data.']
  privilege_category varchar [note: 'Broad classification of the privilege type granted. Clinical covers general patient care; surgical covers operative procedures; procedural covers invasive non-surgical acts; diagnostic covers imaging/interpretation; prescriptive covers medication authority; administrative covers leadership roles.']
  privilege_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the scope and limitations of the clinical privilege, including any conditions, supervision requirements, or volume thresholds specified by the medical staff committee.']
  privilege_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name or title of the clinical privilege granted (e.g., Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy, Cardiac Catheterization, Endotracheal Intubation). Sourced from the facilitys approved privilege delineation form.']
  privilege_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the medical staff office to uniquely reference this privileging grant. Used in correspondence, audit trails, and credentialing system lookups (e.g., Symplr privilege record number).']
  privilege_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the clinical privilege grant. Active indicates full authorization; provisional indicates supervised practice during initial period; suspended indicates temporary removal pending investigation; revoked indicates permanent removal; expired indicates lapsed without renewal; pending indicates awaiting committee approval.']
  privilege_type varchar [note: 'Specific classification of the privilege grant. Core privileges are standard for the specialty; special privileges require additional training; temporary privileges are time-limited; telemedicine covers remote care delivery; locum tenens covers temporary coverage providers; disaster privileges are emergency-activated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: core|special|temporary|telemedicine|locum_tenens|disaster|provisional — promote to reference product]']
  provisional_end_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the provisional privilege period ends and the clinician transitions to full privileges, contingent on satisfactory proctoring evaluation. Null when privilege is not provisional.']
  reappointment_cycle_years varchar [note: 'Number of years in the medical staff reappointment cycle for this privilege (typically 2 years per TJC standards). Determines the frequency of privilege renewal and competency review.']
  request_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the clinician submitted the privilege request or reappointment application to the medical staff office. Used to track processing turnaround time and compliance with credentialing timelines.']
  required_case_volume varchar [note: 'Minimum number of cases or procedures the clinician must perform within the privilege period to demonstrate competency and maintain the privilege. Set by the medical staff committee based on specialty standards.']
  revocation_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the clinical privilege was permanently revoked, if applicable. Null when privilege has not been revoked. Triggers mandatory NPDB adverse action report within 15 days.']
  revocation_reason varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the reason for permanent privilege revocation, such as gross negligence, criminal conviction, license revocation, or sustained peer review findings. Sensitive business-confidential information required for NPDB adverse action reporting.']
  source_record_reference varchar [note: 'Native identifier of this privileging record in the originating operational system (e.g., Symplr privilege record ID, Epic credentialing record ID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL traceability.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this privileging record originated (e.g., SYMPLR for Symplr Credentialing, EPIC for Epic OpTime/Cadence, CERNER for Cerner Millennium, MEDITECH for MEDITECH Expanse, MANUAL for paper-based entry).']
  suspension_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the clinical privilege was suspended, if applicable. Null when privilege has never been suspended. Required for adverse action reporting to the National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB).']
  suspension_reason varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the reason for privilege suspension, such as patient safety concern, peer review finding, license lapse, or investigation pending. Sensitive business-confidential information used for adverse action documentation and NPDB reporting.']
  telemedicine_authorized boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this privilege extends to telemedicine or telehealth delivery of the authorized services. True when the clinician is authorized to perform the privileged activity via remote/virtual care modalities.']
  training_requirement_met boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the clinician has satisfied all required training, education, or competency documentation prerequisites for this privilege as defined on the privilege delineation form. True when all training requirements are verified.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this privileging record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing for the Silver Layer lakehouse.']

  Note: 'Tracks clinical privileges granted to individual clinicians at specific facilities, authorizing them to perform defined procedures and services. Captures privilege category, procedure list, granting facility, privilege status (active, provisional, suspended, revoked), effective and expiration dates, and approving medical staff committee. Core to EMTALA compliance and Joint Commission accreditation.'
}

Records committee review dates, final approval/denial decision, and effective dates. Serves as the consolidated SSOT for the entire credentialing lifecycle workflow — no other product in this domain stores peer references, NPDB queries, malpractice verification, or reappointment cycle data. Compliant with NCQA, Joint Commission, CAQH, and CMS credentialing standards. Sourced from Symplr credentialing workflow.'

Table provider.network_affiliation {

  group_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the medical group or group practice through which the individual provider participates in this network. Many payer contracts are held at the group level, with individual providers enrolled under the group.']
  org_provider_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to provider.org_provider. Business justification: Organizational providers have network affiliations in addition to individual clinicians. FK will be NULL for clinician-only affiliations. No redundant columns to remove.']
  payer_contract_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the provider contract or participation agreement governing the terms of this network affiliation, including reimbursement rates and obligations. Links to the contract management system.']
  payer_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the health insurance payer or managed care organization that owns or administers the network to which the provider is affiliated.']

  specialty_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to provider.specialty. Business justification: Network participation is specialty-specific. network_affiliation.specialty_code and specialty_description should reference specialty table.']

  geographic_service_area varchar [note: 'Description of the geographic region or service area covered by this network affiliation (e.g., state name, county, metropolitan statistical area, or CMS-defined service area). Used for network adequacy geographic analysis and CMS service area filings.']
  handicap_accessible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the providers practice location associated with this network affiliation is handicap accessible per ADA requirements. Required for CMS provider directory accuracy and ADA compliance reporting.']
  hospital_affiliation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this network affiliation record pertains to a hospital or facility provider (as opposed to an individual clinician). Used to distinguish facility-level from practitioner-level network participation in directory and adequacy reporting.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: primary_care|specialist|behavioral_health|hospital|ancillary|pharmacy — promote to reference product if additional categories are needed]']
  network_tier varchar [note: 'Tiered network designation indicating the providers cost and quality tier within the payers network structure. Tier 1 typically represents highest-value providers with lowest patient cost-sharing; higher tiers carry greater patient out-of-pocket costs.']

  npi varchar [note: 'The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the provider participating in this network affiliation. Used for claims routing and provider directory publication.']
  panel_capacity varchar [note: 'Maximum number of patients the provider is willing to accept within this network. Used for network adequacy analysis and patient assignment in managed care models such as HMO and ACO.']
  panel_current_count varchar [note: 'Current number of attributed or assigned patients on the providers panel within this network. Used alongside panel_capacity to determine panel availability and support network adequacy reporting.']
  panel_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the providers patient panel is open to new patients, closed, or accepting only limited new patients within this network. Critical for network adequacy reporting and patient access compliance required by CMS.']
  participation_type varchar [note: 'Defines the providers participation classification within the network. Determines patient cost-sharing levels and reimbursement rates. preferred indicates a higher-tier in-network designation with lower patient cost-sharing.']
  primary_care_designation boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the provider is designated as a Primary Care Physician (PCP) within this network. PCPs serve as care coordinators in HMO and ACO models and are required for patient attribution and referral management.']

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_for_service|capitation|bundled_payment|value_based|salary|per_diem — promote to reference product if additional models are needed]']
  source_record_reference varchar [note: 'The unique identifier of this affiliation record in the originating source system (e.g., Symplr affiliation ID, CAQH provider ID). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL traceability.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this network affiliation record was sourced (e.g., Symplr credentialing platform, CAQH ProView, Epic, Cerner). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.']
  telehealth_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the provider is authorized to deliver telehealth services to patients within this network affiliation. Relevant for network adequacy reporting and patient access under CMS telehealth expansion policies.']
  termination_date date [note: 'The date on which the providers participation in the network ends. Null indicates an open-ended, currently active affiliation. Used for claims adjudication to validate in-network eligibility at date of service.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'Reason code for the termination of the providers network affiliation. Used for network management analytics, OIG compliance monitoring, and understanding provider attrition patterns.']

  Note: 'Association record linking clinicians and organizational providers to payer networks, ACOs, HMOs, PPOs, and integrated care networks. Captures network name, network tier, participation type, effective and termination dates, panel status (open/closed), and geographic service area. Supports provider directory accuracy and network adequacy reporting required by CMS.'

  clinician_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the licensed healthcare professional (physician, nurse practitioner, PA, etc.) for whom this malpractice coverage is maintained. Links to the provider master record.']
  credentialing_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to provider.credentialing_application. Business justification: Malpractice coverage is submitted as part of credentialing applications. FK will be NULL until associated with an application. No redundant columns to remove.']
